scientific_integrity: Mathematical arguments support statements for all integer dimensions at least three. Finite exact-rational verification is supplementary. No independent scientific audit or complete publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only regular Euclidean simplices in dimension at least three are addressed.
Equal maximal distances give fixed points by definition.
No extension to nonregular convex polytopes or other tie rules is proved.
The return contraction rate exists but is not optimized across dimensions.
title: Global orbit classification for the farthest-facet projection map on a regular simplex
